summary.overall: Scheduler tests are behavior-focused and cover recipient filtering, retry count, reminder rerun idempotency, week-close gray creation, partial Sheets failures, draft preservation, silent-notification privacy, and existing weekly report deadline regressions. The original service-level duplicate reminder gap was remediated with a regression test.

coverage_map.behavior: Participant send retry and failure isolation
Reminder rerun idempotency after a successful send
Week close gray report creation and idempotency
Draft preservation and late finalization behavior
Silent notification recipient scope and privacy

findings.title: No service-level test prevents duplicate reminder sends on rerun
findings.description: The repository has a has_successful_reminder test, but SchedulerService.run_reminder is never exercised twice for the same participant/week/reminder type. This means tests pass even when the service records successful reminder state but does not read it.
findings.litmus_test: Remove or ignore the repository has_successful_reminder call in service code: the current service tests still pass.
findings.recommended_test: Add tests/test_scheduler_deadlines.py::test_reminder_rerun_skips_participants_already_successfully_sent. It should run service.run_reminder('wednesday_checkin', now=NOW) twice with one eligible participant, assert only one main-bot message exists, and assert the second result increments skipped_count rather than sent_count.

resolution.summary: Added tests/test_scheduler_deadlines.py::test_reminder_rerun_skips_participants_already_successfully_sent and implemented service-level skip behavior.

findings.title: Acceptance coverage matrix validates only local test names
findings.description: test_scheduler_acceptance_criteria_coverage validates local function names through globals(), but external test references with '::' are treated as documentation strings and are not checked for existence.
findings.litmus_test: Rename an externally referenced test in tests/test_scheduler_foundation.py or tests/test_weekly_report_finalize.py: the coverage matrix still passes.
findings.recommended_test: Either keep the matrix as documentation-only and accept this limitation, or resolve external references against pytest collection if the matrix is intended to be executable traceability.

resolution.summary: Accepted as a low-severity traceability limitation. Behavioral coverage is enforced by the actual pytest smoke commands in Task 7 and pre-deploy QA.
